d: Courtyard of the Virgin Monastery near Moscow. Closer to the spectators is a gate with a small tower in the monastery wall. People's scene The people push themselves lazy and casually around.

Square in the Moscow Kremlin. Opposite the spectators, in the background of the stage-the red free staircase of the Tsar's Palace. Right, closer to the foreground, between the Uspensky and Archangelskykathedrale people, lying on knees. The stair steps of the cathedrals are visible Large bell ringing on stage.
Night. A cell in the monastery of Chudoff. Pimen writes at the light of a lamp. Grigory sleeps
A tavern on the Lithuanian border. Left door and window. Another window in the middle
Room of Marina Mnischek in the castle to Sandomir. Marina sits in front of the mirror and listens to the girls
In the castle garden of Sandomir. A fountain. Moon night. Dimitrij steps into dreaming sunken out of the castle

A forest clearing near Kromy. On the right a slope and behind the city walls. From the slope a path leads across the stage. Gradeaus the forest thicket. Next to the slope a large tree stump. Along the slope a pile of vagabonds storms, in its center the bound Bojar Khrushchoff.

The large reception hall in the Kremlin castle in Moscow. On the sides benches. On the right the exit on the red free staircase, on the left into the inner tsar's chambers. On the right, closer to the ramp, a table with writing device, more to the left, the place for the tsar. Extraordinary session of the Bojarenduma
